_doc: Every contract copy this repo pins from a producer, and the producer branch it must equal. scripts/harness/pinned_contract_gate.py fails when a copy differs from the producer's develop. Refresh = copy the file, never edit it. The yard-management entry pins THIS repo's own apis/asyncapi.yaml (the analytics self-subscription of ADR 0004): it fails the gate the moment a spec change lands on develop without this repo's consumer contract tests following it.
